nodes.label: Icon Dark (SVG)
nodes.description: Ordermatrix brand icon for dark theme. 240x240 SVG. Outer ring (stroke only, #F4F1EB off-white/cream, no fill) enclosing a 3x3 dot-grid where 8 of 9 positions are filled with small circles (#F4F1EB), and the top-right position carries a larger accent circle in #EC6240 (coral/orange-red). The accent dot represents a highlighted or active matrix cell. Background is transparent (dark theme implied). aria-label='Ordermatrix'.
